router.balance: N * sum(stopgrad(top2_assignment_fraction) * mean(full_router_softmax)), averaged over steps; diagnostic auxiliary only

additional_gates: three-seed total GPU-hours and per-session schedule freeze

matching.F: declared dense-matmul MAC=2 active forward cost at context256; runtime profiling separate

counterfactual.oracle: bounded optional offline path diagnostic; NOT_RUN in initial smoke

checkpoint_policy.recovery: reuse repair_io transport, <=3 saved versions, <=45s; published same-source progress with failed recovery blocks retraining
checkpoint_policy.objects: immutable content-addressed snapshots plus atomic recovery manifest
